business_summary: Minth Group Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, processes, and sells automobile body parts and moulds of passenger cars. The company manufactures, develops, and sells motor systems for electric vehicles, as well as metal molds, automobile body parts; automobile body parts manufacturing equipment, automation machines, software, production lines, and automobile drives; and offers bookkeeping services. It also engages in the import and export trading, wholesale of packaging materials, logistics, and technology import activities; manufacture and sale of electrical and electronic equipment; production, operation trading, and import and export trade of deformed aluminum alloys, aluminum profiles, and aluminum extrusion moulds; and research, design, development, sales, import, and export of robots. In addition, the company provides automobile glass, light metals casting, customer, research and market development, general business, business management, nursery, internet information, trading, technology service and development, market development, non-ferrous metal smelting, power supply, engineering, management and technical consulting, properties services management, retail sales, and consulting services, as well as act as an agent for sales of automobile body parts and purchase of raw materials. Further, it involved in the design and production of civil aircraft parts; manufacturing of photovoltaic panels; research, development, manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service of energy vehicle drive systems and parts; and manufacture of other parts and accessories for motor vehicles. The company operates in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Japan, Thailand, Germany, Serbia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Korea, France, the Czech Republic, Canada, and Poland. Minth Group Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.
business_summary_ko: 투자지주회사인 Minth Group Limited는 승용차 차체 부품 및 금형을 설계, 개발, 제조, 가공, 판매하는 회사입니다. 이 회사는 전기 자동차용 모터 시스템뿐만 아니라 금형, 자동차 차체 부품을 제조, 개발 및 판매합니다. 자동차 차체 부품 제조 장비, 자동화 기계, 소프트웨어, 생산 라인 및 자동차 드라이브; 그리고 부기 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 수출입 무역, 포장재 도매, 물류 및 기술 수입 활동에 종사하고 있습니다. 전기 및 전자 장비의 제조 및 판매; 변형 알루미늄 합금, 알루미늄 프로파일, 알루미늄 압출 금형의 생산, 운영 무역, 수출입 무역; 로봇의 연구, 설계, 개발, 판매, 수입 및 수출을 담당하고 있습니다. 또한 자동차 유리, 경금속 주조, 고객, 연구 및 시장 개발, 일반 사업, 경영 관리, 보육, 인터넷 정보, 무역, 기술 서비스 및 개발, 시장 개발, 비철 금속 제련, 전원 공급, 엔지니어링, 경영 및 기술 컨설팅, 부동산 서비스를 제공합니다.
